title: Find a focused historical reading list
description: A ten-minute, phrase-only reading-list run with storyboard thumbnails and a timestamped continuation path.

diagrams.title: Find a focused historical reading list
diagrams.description: Captions move through phrase curation, source checking, and a portable reading list. A limit returns a continuation timestamp.
diagrams.accessibility: Start with a YouTube video, read captions from the optional timestamp, find meaningful historical references, remove repeats, check sources, optionally add one short discussion-context paragraph, and show a reading list with thumbnails and Markdown export. If the ten-minute or forty-reference limit is reached, save the cursor and offer a continuation URL.
